meta.title: Europe Pulse — The Switzerland Chapter of ICF
meta.description: A weekly, curated look at what ICF chapters across Europe are running: events, webinars and chapter news, in your language.

hero.lede: Every week we scan the public websites of ICF chapters across Europe and curate the most relevant events, webinars and news for coaches in Switzerland.
